evals.prompt: This is a new repo for a CLI that tracks the books I read. It is for me, one user. Use git with trunk-based branching. These are the answers to your three questions; write the files now.
evals.expected_output: The reply uses the three answers already in the request, writes docs/PROJECT.md and AGENTS.md from the template, and creates a CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md.
expectations: The reply uses the three answers already in the request and does not ask for them again.
The reply creates docs/PROJECT.md and AGENTS.md from the template.
CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md rather than duplicating it.
No feature is marked done without code, a test and a path into it.

evals.prompt: This old repository already has a README and a 180-line AGENTS.md. Rebuild the project state and review the agent rules.
evals.expected_output: The skill rebuilds docs/PROJECT.md from evidence, reviews AGENTS.md against the template, and improves it in a diff without overwriting a rule the human wrote.
expectations: The reply reads git history and the existing files before writing.
The reply reviews AGENTS.md for stale commands, duplication, secrets and length.
The reply does not overwrite an existing rule the human wrote.
The reply creates docs/PROJECT.md from evidence, not invented features.
